Ranma1/2: Season 3 | Official Trailer | Netflix Anime
The slapstick, action-packed romcom returns with a third season! Ranma Saotome and Akane Tendo are betrothed to each other by their parents. However, Ranma has a unique problem: after falling into the cursed springs of Jusenkyo while training in China, he now turns into a girl when doused in cold water and reverts to a guy in hot water!

Ranma1/2: Season 3 premieres October 3 only on Netflix, bringing back existing rivals and a vibrant new cast of characters!

Why not check out Seasons 1 and 2 on Netflix in the meantime?
